cards.front: Which programming language does the flashcards server use? Start with the letter P.
cards.back: Python (standard library only, no external dependencies).

cards.front: What MCP transport does flashcards_server.py speak?
Where do custom flashcard decks get stored?
How do you re-draw the exact same shuffled quiz twice?
cards.back: Pass the same 'seed' string to draw_quiz; same seed gives the same order.

cards.front: While studying, which tool shows answers without spoilers?
cards.back: draw_quiz hides answers server-side and reveal_answer shows one at a time.
